name: Long Range Sentry Tower w/ fire control (Anduril)
description: Autonomous Lattice-native tower carrying an ultra-high-powered 360 deg radar that Anduril states identifies, classifies and tracks Group 1-3 drones up to 15 km. SIMPLIFICATION: the real tower is a multi-sensor mast that fuses radar, visible and mid-wave IR on board; RangeBoard models one sensor per SpecModel, so only the radar is modelled because the radar is what gives the tower its C-UAS reach.

detectRangeM.condition: 2000 m against Group 1 (2 to 4 km; 15 km for Group 3+)
detectRangeM.note: Inventory records 15000 m (15 km); the seed value is kept

classifyRangeM.condition: classification range — UNKNOWN. Anduril states the radar is 'designed to identify, classify and track group 1-3 drone threats' but publishes no separate classification range, and the 15 km figure is written against detection and tracking only. null rather than a copy of detectRangeM, following the radar-domain agent's convention. Consequence in the engine: this sensor alone will not promote a track to hostile; the track reaches hostile when it enters an effector envelope.
